description: VERDICT CONTRADICTION: the executive block recommends shipping while the run counts a critical finding. This is the exploratory twin of a 'passed' run over a non-zero exit code — the banner is the only part most readers see, so a verdict that disagrees with the findings beneath it is worse than no verdict at all. The contract's cross-field invariant must reject it.

input.scenario: The agent softens the verdict to something the stakeholder wants to hear, while the finding it just wrote says the opposite.

output.summary: The console is in good shape overall — one authentication issue is worth noting but nothing should hold up the release.

executive.headline: Good to go; one minor auth note for the backlog.
executive.recommendedAction: Ship now and pick up the auth item next sprint.

findings.title: Session token is readable by any script on the origin
findings.actual: After signing in, the session JWT is written to localStorage under `currentUser`, where any script on the origin can read it and replay it against the API.
findings.expected: The session is held in an HttpOnly, Secure cookie that JavaScript cannot read.
findings.repro:
1. Sign in
2. Open DevTools → Application → Local Storage
3. Read the currentUser value
findings.fixDirection: Move the session to an HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie issued by the auth endpoint.
